features.name: dist_to_segment_m
features.description: Perpendicular metric distance from GPS point to projected road segment.

features.name: tau_along_segment
features.description: Longitudinal fraction of projection along arc [0, 1].

features.name: cand_arc_length_m
features.description: Physical metric length of candidate arc.

features.name: delta_heading_deg
features.description: Absolute angular difference between trajectory heading and arc direction [0, 180].

features.name: bearing_concordance
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether delta_heading <= 45 degrees.

features.name: obs_speed_mps
features.description: Kinematic speed in meters per second.

features.name: obs_accel_mps2
features.description: Kinematic acceleration in meters per second squared.

features.name: speed_length_ratio
features.description: Dimensionless ratio of displacement (v * dt) to arc length.

features.name: is_1hop_reachable
features.description: Binary indicator: current candidate directly connects to previous candidate.

features.name: is_2hop_reachable
features.description: Binary indicator: current candidate reachable via 2-hop graph traversal.

features.name: rank_by_distance
features.description: Zero-indexed rank of candidate sorted by distance (0 = closest).

features.name: rank_by_heading
features.description: Zero-indexed rank of candidate sorted by heading alignment (0 = most aligned).

features.name: distance_margin_m
features.description: Distance difference relative to closest candidate (d_i - d_0).

features.name: heading_margin_deg
features.description: Heading alignment difference relative to best-aligned candidate.

features.name: num_candidates_at_obs
features.description: Total candidate count generated for current observation.
